plugins.name: android-skills
plugins.description: Android skills are Google's official dedicated repository of AI-optimized, modular instructions and resources, to help LLMs better understand and execute specific patterns that follow the best practices and guidance on Android development. Android skills follow the open-standard agent skills - markdown files (SKILL.md) that provide a technical specification of a task, and ground LLMs with information on specialized domains and workflows.
